text.lead: Estranged is a 2006, 20-minute short film directed by D. J. Matrundola. The film is about a character named Chloe who is forced to reunite with her estranged brother, Julian, and drive down to their mother's hometown. Julian shows up with a precocious twelve-year-old girl named Suzy, unwanted by her divorcing parents and hitching a ride to her aunt's house.
text.cast:
- Freya Ravensbergen as Chloe
- Éléonore Lamothe as Suzy
- Paul Burke as Julian
text.reception:
- "Estranged is only 20 minutes yet it packs a lot of punch". --Ryan Cracknell, Movie Views
- "Estranged is an entertaining dysfunctional family short, with talent behind every inch of film". --Felix Vasquez Jr., Cinema Crazed
